objective: Complete a G2 hardware emulator and development tools for functional verification that can execute original stock, Faceclaw, and new CFW candidates and reproduce and compare screen, input, sensor, communication, storage, reset, and failure behavior.

groups.D: Peer communication, comparison, and development workflow

criteria.title: Pin inputs, assets, and models and reject unsuitable inputs
criteria.acceptance: Pin inputs and models for the three research baseline images and selected profiles by hash and provenance. Identify missing assets and unverified initial values, and reject tampered or unsuitable inputs. This does not imply a normal font bank has been obtained or compatibility of all profiles is complete.

criteria.title: Reproduce original M55 reset execution and stop in a pinned environment
criteria.acceptance: Reproduce stop location and observations from original main reset under the same pinned environment, inputs, and profile. Distinguish this from app startup or completed ROM cold boot.

criteria.title: Declared basic set of M55 exceptions, IRQ, and memory protection
criteria.acceptance: Verify some MVE, SVC/PendSV/IRQ0/SysTick in the pinned smoke set and rejection of main writes, out-of-range access, and unwritten ITCM execution. This is not certification of the full M55 ISA, security, or timing accuracy.

criteria.title: Register new CFW candidate and check layout/compatibility profile
criteria.acceptance: Register a new candidate beyond the three research images with independent SHA, layout, and compatibility declaration. Reject incorrect size, vectors, or target profile and run it on the baseline runner. Forced acceptance of addresses/hashes alone does not pass.

criteria.title: Process service and app events from original main reset
criteria.acceptance: Stock 2.4/2.3/Faceclaw38 pass required service initialization and process actual RTOS app events under the declared virtual-board profile. Assess task progress, wait/resume, and absence of errors in pinned scenarios. Exclude forced branch/return/TCB changes from integration evidence.

criteria.title: Virtual reset during execution and restart state
criteria.acceptance: Trigger virtual reset at the device boundary during E05 execution. Declare volatile/retained state and reinitialization results, and check whether the original returns to app state. Do not substitute a host PC reset alone.

criteria.title: Guest persistent writes, restart reads, and range preservation
criteria.acceptance: Data written by original firmware to virtual MRAM/NOR is read after restart. Check allowed write/erase ranges and preservation of neighboring data; keep original input files unchanged.

criteria.title: Assess storage failures, interruptions, and version mismatches
criteria.acceptance: Assess the extent of corruption and restart outcomes in pinned write/erase failure, interruption, and data/version mismatch scenarios. Do not mask failures as success; distinguish recoverable cases from explicit failure.

criteria.title: Natural main UI → render → submit → 576×288 viewer
criteria.acceptance: UI generated by legitimate original-main initialization/input produces actual guest pixels through rendering and submission. Verify the 576×288 screen and original frame provenance in the viewer. Preserve synthetic caller and host-prepared pixels only as partial evidence.

criteria.title: Continuous screen refresh according to firmware time and events
criteria.acceptance: Original code generates continuous frames in declared time/event scenarios. Capture frame order, content changes, and completion/waiting; do not interpret simulator speed as physical FPS.
criteria.next_action: Verified stock24 first dashboard followed by 100.695 ms, five continuously completed sources, sequence/content changes, and sleep/wake. Long-duration behavior, additional input, and physical FPS/accuracy are separate.

criteria.title: Virtual touch/input → original consumption → state/screen change
criteria.acceptance: Deliver supported v1 inputs such as touch/ring at bus/GPIO/IRQ device boundaries. Original tasks consume events and produce expected state/UI changes. Controller version/config queries alone are not input success.
criteria.next_action: Declared v1 touch wake/additional scroll and ring wake integrated with three originals' UI/screens. Arbitrary gestures/direct R1 BLE remain additional unsupported scope. Next E12 natural sensor-task sample consumption and final audit of all 16 conditions.

criteria.title: Virtual sensor samples → FIFO/IRQ → original consumption
criteria.acceptance: Deliver supported IMU/required auxiliary sensor samples through virtual bus, FIFO, and IRQ and verify actual original consumption results. Identification/initial configuration alone is not successful sample processing.
criteria.next_action: Three originals FIFO32/WM10 → GPIO38/IRQ57 → natural sensor_hub consumption/numerical results and subsequent UI complete. criteria.title: Virtual phone/peer messages → app behavior
criteria.acceptance: Declare scenario-specific roles for virtual phone/opposite temple/case. Supported messages flow through virtual transport → original protocol/task → app behavior. Initial HCI responses alone do not complete app communication.
criteria.next_action: E13 local phone time-setting scenario complete. Opposite temple/case runtime and outbound sync delivery are disclosed as unverified. E14 verifies disconnect/delay/malformed messages and original cleanup/reconnect/explicit failure in the same runner.

criteria.title: Disconnect, delay, malformed messages, and reconnect/failure
criteria.acceptance: Inject virtual peer disconnects, delays, and malformed messages and verify original timeout/error/state and reconnect or explicit failure. Unconditional ready/ack responses are prohibited.
criteria.next_action: Acceptance audit of nine pinned communication failure/recovery scenarios complete. Verify additional originals/error categories against the declared strict contract and new evidence. Track new-connection ATT and complete app functionality under adjacent conditions.

criteria.title: Compare stock/new CFW in the same scenarios and assess regressions
criteria.acceptance: Run an E04 new candidate with the same board/input/time scenarios. Separately assess intended code/display changes and preserved boot/input/communication behavior, distinguishing model/fixture differences from firmware regressions.
criteria.next_action: Separately verified intended changes/preservation/actual regressions/model differences in six pinned API-screen and virtual-phone pairs of three originals/new candidate. Extend new code/scenarios/original families using explicit profiles and independent expectations. Natural main/full UI completion assessed separately in E05/E09.

criteria.title: One-command execution, scenarios, frame/events, and comparison report
criteria.acceptance: A developer obtains candidate execution, scenarios, frames/events, stop/failure causes, and comparison results with one documented command and reproduces them with a pinned profile. Also verify new-environment installation, missing-asset guidance, and interrupted-process cleanup.
criteria.next_action: Verified seven native runs/comparisons, missing-asset guidance, and bw437 cleanup evidence in a fresh venv and empty private root on pinned Mac arm64/Python 3.14.
